title: 查看语录配置
subtitle: 当前群组配置信息
code:
[showcase]
max_rank_user_num = 15
max_list_page_size = 10

[collection]

collect_interval_hours = 24
min_message_count = 50

require_review = false

[display]

show_comment_in_card = true
